
         ent  $

MAINLOOP call SCANNER
         call SHOWKEYS

         call 8020
         jr   c,MAINLOOP
         ret

SHOWKEYS ld   hl,KEYBOARD
         ld   ix,22528+33
         ld   b,4
SHOW1    ld   c,10
SHOW0    ld   a,(hl)
         inc  hl
         ld   (ix+0),a
         ld   (ix+1),a
         ld   (ix+32),a
         ld   (ix+33),a
         inc  ix
         inc  ix
         inc  ix
         dec  c
         jr   nz,SHOW0
         ld   de,66
         add  ix,de
         djnz SHOW1
         ret


SCANNER  ld   hl,PORTTAB
         ld   ix,KEYBOARD
         ld   e,4
         ld   c,254

SCAN1    ld   b,(hl)
         inc  hl
         push hl
         ld   d,5
         ld   hl,BITTAB

SCAN2    in   a,(c)
         cpl
         and  (hl)
         inc  hl
         jr   z,SCAN2B
         ld   a,255
SCAN2B   ld   (ix+0),a
         inc  ix
         dec  d
         jr   nz,SCAN2

         pop  hl
         ld   b,(hl)
         inc  hl
         push hl
         ld   d,5
         ld   hl,BITTAB+4

SCAN3    in   a,(c)
         cpl
         and  (hl)
         dec  hl
         jr   z,SCAN3B
         ld   a,255
SCAN3B   ld   (ix+0),a
         inc  ix
         dec  d
         jr   nz,SCAN3

         pop  hl
         dec  e
         jr   nz,SCAN1
         ret


PORTTAB  defb 247,239
         defb 251,223
         defb 253,191
         defb 254,127

BITTAB   defb 1,2,4,8,16

KEYBOARD defs 8*5
